$comment: Rendered once by dop-amine/catalog templates/docs (catalog 07.2); edit freely afterwards.
This repo declares which rails it is on, so an interactive session opened here gets
them whether or not this machine installed them at user scope.
Use the owner/repo shorthand, never a clone URL: matching does not normalise URLs,
so a git+url subscription to the same repository is a different value and will not resolve.
Project-scope extraKnownMarketplaces is ignored without workspace trust, including under
claude -p, so this is a declaration of intent for trusted interactive work — NOT the
enabledPlugins alone does not install (since Claude Code 2.1.195): on a machine that never
ran `claude plugin install`, this file enables nothing and says nothing about it.
